faqs.question: Is the site handicap accessible?
faqs.answer: Yes.

faqs.question: Does your venue have specific time requirements for start of dinner and cake cutting? If so, what are the requirements?
faqs.answer: No specific time, you let us know what time will work for you so we can plan accordingly.

faqs.question: How long does it typically take to flip the room from ceremony to reception?
faqs.answer: Around 45 minutes to 1 hour.

faqs.question: Do you provide a coat check service?
faqs.answer: Yes, it comes with the complete package or on the rental when you have 2 security guards.

faqs.question: Does your venue have signage that can be placed on the street directing guests to the alternate parking area?
faqs.answer: Yes.

faqs.question: There are several upgrades that I would like to purchase. How late can I make a decision?
faqs.answer: Two weeks before the event day, but the sooner the better so we can be prepared for your event!

faqs.question: Does your venue make adjustments for guests that may not eat red meat or are vegetarian?
faqs.answer: Yes, we just need to know exactly where they are seated.

faqs.question: Does your venue have a built-in mechanism for handling guest overage?
faqs.answer: We might be able to accommodate them but we cannot guarantee it.

faqs.question: How far in advance can we reserve our wedding date?
faqs.answer: We are booking 2 years in advance.

faqs.question: How much is the deposit to reserve the venue, and is a payment plan available?
faqs.answer: $1,000 to secure your day. Monthly payments are available; balance for Rentals is due 60 days before the event day, and for the Complete Package, 30 days before.

faqs.question: What forms of payment do you accept?
faqs.answer: Cash, check, money order, credit card, and Zelle.

faqs.question: Does your venue only host one wedding at a time?
faqs.answer: Yes, we only have one room. We can accommodate 2 events per day, one in the morning and one in the evening.

faqs.question: When is the last possible date to make changes to our reservation?
faqs.answer: 15 days before the event day.

faqs.question: Do you have a list of approved or recommended vendors we can use?
faqs.answer: We can certainly recommend some vendors, but you can bring in any vendor of your choice. We don't have any limitations. We welcome everyone.

faqs.question: What kind of food do you offer?
faqs.answer: American, Italian, Mexican, Puerto Rican, or you can bring the food of your choice and we'll take care of everything else.

faqs.question: Can we do a food tasting before we finalize our menu selection? Does it cost extra?
faqs.answer: Yes, after signing a contract we'll set up a free food tasting.

faqs.question: What is included in the room rental?
faqs.answer: The room rental only includes tables and silver Chiavari chairs. You're responsible for bringing any additional items.

faqs.question: Can I bring in a cake or dessert from an outside bakery?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Is there a cake-cutting fee if I bring my own cake?
faqs.answer: No cake-cutting fee if we're providing the professional staff.

faqs.question: What options do we have for the bar?
faqs.answer: Open bar, cash bar, or you can also bring in your own alcohol.

faqs.question: Are there additional charges for bartenders?
faqs.answer: Yes, $225 per bartender. We require 1 bartender for every 150 guests.

faqs.question: Is there a private room for the bride, bridesmaids, or quinceañera?
faqs.answer: Yes, a spacious private dressing room including a vanity and toilet.

faqs.question: Can the venue accommodate a DJ?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can bring your own DJ. They'll have access to a table, but must bring anything else related to music and lighting.

faqs.question: Is there parking on site, and is it complimentary?
faqs.answer: Yes, 2 parking lots with more than 75 spaces. One is across from the venue; the other is a block away.

faqs.question: Are cabs/rideshares easily accessible from the venue?
faqs.answer: Yes, right in front of the venue.
